365:t_3:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...That $$ギルター$$... Rushing for glory and getting hooked by such an obvious diversion. He's a hopeless idiot.」

365:t_3:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But I'm in luck. I meant to confirm the truth about the two Reactors in $$ストラウス$$'s report, and now they've come to me.」

365:t_3:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Heh heh... $$セツコ$$... Perhaps this is what they call fate.」

365:t_3:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I've been waiting for you, $$セツコ$$. I could feel that you were close.」

365:t_3:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And welcome to you as well, $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

365:t_3:10.en:
$n
「I'm paying you back for everything so far, $$バルビエル$$!」

365:t_3:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You came all this way just to see my face for that...? Only a fool who mistakes recklessness for courage would do that.」

365:t_3:12.en:
$n
「Don't think a provocation like that will shake me.」

365:t_3:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You mean to say you've grown...? Very well, I'll admit that much.」

365:t_3:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But in the end... you're just a bystander.」

365:t_3:15.en:
$n
「Then I'll make you unable to ignore me, by force!」

365:t_3:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$... Are you saying you intend to defeat me with your own hands?」

365:t_3:19.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I... want to know about you.」

365:t_3:21.en:
$$セツコ$$
「What you're fighting for... where your hatred comes from...」

365:t_3:23.en:
$$セツコ$$
「When we spent time together on the $$翠の地球$$... you seemed a little sad...」

365:t_3:25.en:
$n
「You're going to reach out a hand... to a guy like this...?」

365:t_3:27.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I've also had times when... like you, my heart was about to be ruled by hatred...」

365:t_3:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But I felt even sadder than that... that fighting like this goes on...」

365:t_3:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's why I want to know your heart... and the sorrow inside you...」

365:t_3:30.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...$$セツコ・オハラ$$... the $$悲しみの乙女$$...」

365:t_3:31.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「As I thought, your existence... can't be allowed!」

365:t_3:33.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Normally, killing a Reactor is forbidden... But you're the exception...!」

365:t_3:34.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル$$! I won't let you have your way with $$セツコ$$!」

365:t_3:35.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Fall back, $$セツコ$$! His target is you!」

365:t_3:38.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shall I put $$ストラウス$$'s report to the test...!」

365:t_3:39.en:
$n
「You're going to use the power of the $$スフィア$$!」

365:t_3:40.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right! I'll amplify the hatred sleeping in your hearts!」

365:t_3:43.en:
$n
「The $$スフィア$$... $$バルビエル$$'s power and $$セツコ$$'s collided...?!」

365:t_3:49.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's not it! It's Miss $$スズネ$$...!」

365:t_3:52.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Please, pull yourself together!」

365:t_3:53.en:
$n
「We're falling back, $$セツコ$$! I'm calling the $$ジェニオン$$!」

365:t_3:54.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$... Even if only for a moment, you stood up to my power...」

365:t_3:55.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Oh well. I've achieved my goal.」

365:t_3:56.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now all that's left is to wait for the poison to take effect.」

365:t_4:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Get out of the $$ジェニオン$$, $n! I can't let you have this!」

365:t_4:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's better that way, for you... and for the world! Get out of the way!!」

365:t_5:4.en:
$$シン$$
「...So Miss $$スズネ$$ got hit by $$バルビエル$$'s poison?」

365:t_5:6.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「No way... That means that somewhere in her heart, Miss $$スズネ$$ hated $n...」

365:t_5:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I agree with $$キラ$$. I can't believe Miss $$スズネ$$ was thinking anything like that.」

365:t_5:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What do the rest of the Volunteer Club think?」

365:t_5:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ was... not herself back then.」

365:t_5:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「Sure, there've been times before when stress made her act a little strange, but to get violent like that...」

365:t_5:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes... I think it's very likely $$バルビエル$$ used some kind of mind control.」

365:t_5:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「That bastard... He's got that kind of power too...?」

365:t_5:15.en:
$$シン$$
「So... will Miss $$スズネ$$ go back to normal?」

365:t_5:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I can't say. We don't yet know how the power of the $$スフィア$$ is acting on her.」

365:t_5:18.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm sorry... If I had shot $$バルビエル$$ back then...」
